# mtncloud_router (Data Source)

Looks up one MTN Router by ID or by name, including one made in the console. A name must match exactly one router. To list them, use `mtncloud_routers`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A router made in the console, by name; `id = 123` works too.
data "mtncloud_router" "edge" {
  name = "edge"
}

output "edge_public_ip" {
  value = data.mtncloud_router.edge.external_ip
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) Router ID. Give this or `name`.
- `name` (String) Router name, matched exactly. Give this or `id`.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Router description, or empty.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the router is enabled.
- `external_ip` (String) Its public IP on the external network, or empty.
- `external_network` (String) The external network that is its gateway, or empty without one.
- `networks` (List of Number) IDs of the MTN Networks it connects.
- `status` (String) Status, for example `ok`.
